notice: Native numeric support for float row/column matrices, six float/int vector types, byte/float colours and int/float rectangles. Records include definitions and declarations, type aliases and fields. Supporting operations remain native; related JS consumers are not new JS arithmetic APIs. No arbitrary custom type/platform claim. The parser omitted conversion operators and private multiplier specializations; source-only findings are separate.

matrix-proxies.contract: Actual float packed/strided storage, indexed writes, copied const columns and mutable packed references.

matrix-storage.contract: Float row/column constructors, copies, raw layout, diagonal, const/mutable indexing, row/column setters and transpose aliases; same-storage arithmetic and scalar division.

matrix-mixed.contract: Both cross-storage assignments, addition/subtraction, comparisons and in-place assignment/addition/subtraction of one's transposed view.

matrix-multiplication.contract: Independent component products for all four float storage pairs; in-place matrix multiplication and both vector multipliers.

matrix-inversion.contract: Both float storages: determinant, inverse in both product orders and unchanged singular destination.

matrix-transforms.contract: Float translation/scaling, normalized axis rotations, skew, perspective/orthographic projections and independent Compose values including nonidentity quaternion and perspective.

vector-arithmetic.contract: Six float/int Vector2/3/4 types: constructors, layout, component pointers, unary/scalar/vector arithmetic, dot/magnitudes, comparisons and float normalization including zero/near-zero preservation.

vector-specials.contract: Float/int Vector2 component arithmetic and rotation, both rounding specializations, casts, float/int cross products and perspective divide.

colour-byte.contract: Byte constructors, wrapping/truncating channel arithmetic, layout, alpha conversion, opacity, zero-alpha and rounded interpolation.

colour-float.contract: Float constructors, channel arithmetic, comparison and pointer layout.

rectangles.contract: Int/float corners, fields, dimensions, inclusive containment, strict overlap, invalidity, extension/join/translation and truncating casts.

math.contract: Actual native functions, scalar and float/int Vector2 min/max/clamp, interpolation, angles, distinct negative rounding, hexadecimal and power-of-two conversion.

pixel-grid.contract: All five native snapping/expansion overloads use explicit edge results.

random-real.contract: Actual Math object with controlled rand endpoints; positive finite strict bounds from the minimum positive normal float to its maximum.

random-integer.contract: Actual Math object: positive integer modulus, boolean endpoints and zero floating scale; no runtime lifecycle stubs.

js_consumers.contract: Fixed column-major matrices and owned snapshots; 1k/10k/100k refresh uses one entry with zero callbacks, ownership visits and buffer allocations. Explicit matrix copies are measured, not claimed zero.
Copied column-major transforms, exact int32 scissors, actual pixels, offset fixed buffers; detached/shared/resizable buffers rejected.
Native primitive lists, checked angular/relative values and independent decomposed matrix vector snapshots.
Native geometry owns packed position/colour storage; uploads, translations, resource lifetime and rendered pixels are checked.
Byte premultiplied colours, independent lists, native parsing and checked channel/unit values.
Native float vector/colour storage, checked integer vector conversion destinations and exact snapshot/default semantics.

source_only_review.finding: The private generic MatrixMultiplier vector Multiply declaration has no definition or public route. Actual public vector multiplication instantiates VectorMultiplier for both storages; matrix multiplication instantiates three MatrixMultiplier specializations for four storage pairs.
Packed/strided conversion operators and dimensional/pointer vector conversions omitted by the original parser execute in the probes. They do not create original inventory rows.
